component.name: Punknova font family
component.summary: OpenType version of Knuth's Punk font

description.p: The font was generated from a METAPOST version of the sources of the ‘original’ punk font. Knuth’s original fonts generated different shapes at random. This isn't actually possible in an OpenType font; rather, the font contains several variants of each glyph, and uses the OpenType randomize function to select a variant for each invocation.
